name: SLOPE Development Roadmap
description: Forward-looking roadmap from S61+. Phases 1-9 (S1-S47) are complete. S48-S60 were hardening, guard enforcement, and process sprints. This roadmap covers adoption, observability, guard maturity, multi-project, and loop evolution. S61-S64 reflect what actually shipped (themes diverged from original plan). Note: the actual S69 diverged from the planned Referee sprint — a carryover patch kit ran instead. The Referee work was rescheduled as S78. S75.5 (The Bug Clearing) added 2026-05-02 to clear accumulated CLI bugs from external repos.

phases.name: Phase 12 — Guard Maturity
phases.note: S69 diverged — patch kit ran instead of The Referee. The Referee was rescheduled and now sits at S78 (renumbered after S73 Caddy's Notes was inserted). S80 added 2026-04-30 to address GH issues #290/#291 (sprint hygiene — read-side surfacing + post-hole command).

phases.note: Builds the drift-detection scaffolding (S86) the project lacked during S70-S84, and clears accumulated CLI bugs from external users (S87, supersedes S75.5).

phases.name: Phase 19 — Agent Developer Experience
phases.note: Machine-readable state + bundled workflow commands. Foundation for agent-driven SLOPE usage filed as #309-316.

phases.name: Phase 20 — Architecture & Automation
phases.note: Memory↔store reunification (architectural debt from PR #293) + automation hooks for PR/issue/branch hygiene.

phases.name: Phase 21 — Backlog Cleanup
phases.note: Closed the 3 remaining backlog items (#307, #318, #323) from the Phase 18-20 sweep. Shipped in v1.55.0.

phases.name: Phase 22 — Codex Hook Recovery
phases.note: Recover Codex hook support after validating current Codex CLI hook docs and local 0.130 behavior.

phases.name: Phase 23 — Guard Enforcement Hardening
phases.note: Closed the remaining enforcement/diagnostic gaps exposed by #368: full dispatcher coverage, Codex matcher coverage, stale runtime detection, configurable strictness for implementation writes outside sprint state, and transport-independent PR review handoff. Shipped in v1.55.6.

phases.name: Phase 24 — Sprint State Inference
phases.note: Resolve #364 by making roadmap-inserted sub-sprints and missing active state explicit in next/status/briefing and guard guidance.

phases.name: Phase 25 — Vision & Roadmap Generation Repair
phases.note: Close #376/#377 by preserving natural-language vision priorities and making roadmap generation refuse shallow placeholder output when backlog analysis yields no concrete work.

phases.name: Phase 26 — Review Recommendation Repair
phases.note: Fix the follow-up found during S96: review recommendation should understand table-form sprint plans generated by slope sprint plan before Codex plugin work resumes.

phases.name: Phase 27 — Guard Noise & Workflow Phase Repair
phases.note: Close #382/#383 before Codex plugin work: suppress repeated explore guidance and make workflow per-ticket state advance sprint-state into implementing.

phases.name: Phase 28 — Issue Recovery & Release Maintenance
phases.note: Syncs the completed issue, release, and maintenance sprints that shipped after the original S101 roadmap tail.

phases.note: Add repo-local skill registry, skill validation, scorecard skill fields, and skill-aware briefing for #431.

phases.note: Close the remaining #431 acceptance gap and fix decimal sprint follow-on inference.

phases.note: Used the SLOPE-generated local backlog to harden the worktree-check guard against recurring multi-session and payload-shape hazards.
